Read execution records, filter project history, and wait for terminal state.

## `ExecutionsClient`

Read and poll the executor's project-scoped execution records.

### `get`

Retrieves one execution record by identifier.

The public record may include bounded replay, verified voice-session source,
and staged-file ID/count provenance. It never includes canonical input, raw
or derived idempotency identity, or staged-file bytes.

```ts no-check
get(executionId: string): Promise<ExecutionRecord>
```

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `executionId` | <code>string</code> | Yes | Execution identifier returned by `tools.execute`. |

**Returns:** <code>Promise&lt;ExecutionRecord&gt;</code>

**Throws**

- EyeballError when the execution is unavailable or the request fails.

**Example**

```ts
import { Eyeball } from "@eyeball/sdk";

const eyeball = new Eyeball({
  apiKey: process.env.EYEBALL_API_KEY!,
  baseUrl: process.env.EYEBALL_EXECUTOR_URL!,
});

const execution = await eyeball.executions.get(
  "exe_01JZ6WA0Q73ZQ5B51SRYB6M4Z8",
);
if (execution.replayed === true) console.log("Accepted replay observed");
if (execution.source?.kind === "voice_session") {
  console.log(execution.source.sessionId);
}
for (const fileId of execution.attachments?.fileIds ?? []) {
  console.log(fileId);
}
```

### `list`

Lists execution history with optional status, tool, user, and cursor filters.
Items preserve the same optional bounded provenance as `get`; canonical
input, idempotency identity, and file bytes remain private.

```ts no-check
list(options?: ListExecutionsOptions): Promise<ExecutionPage>
```

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `options` | <code>ListExecutionsOptions</code> | No | Filters and pagination for the project execution history. |

**Returns:** <code>Promise&lt;ExecutionPage&gt;</code>

**Throws**

- EyeballError when a filter is invalid or the executor request fails.

### `wait`

Polls an execution until it succeeds or fails, bounded by a local deadline.
The terminal record preserves optional replay, verified source, and staged-file
summary fields without exposing canonical input, idempotency identity, or bytes.

```ts no-check
wait(executionId: string, options?: WaitForExecutionOptions): Promise<(ExecutionBase & { userId: string; createdAt: string; startedAt?: string; completedAt?: string; readonly replayed?: true; readonly source?: ExecutionSource; readonly attachments?: ExecutionAttachmentSummary; } & { status: "succeeded"; output: JsonValue; error?: never; latencyMs: number; } & { status: "succeeded" | "failed"; }) | (ExecutionBase & { userId: string; createdAt: string; startedAt?: string; completedAt?: string; readonly replayed?: true; readonly source?: ExecutionSource; readonly attachments?: ExecutionAttachmentSummary; } & { status: "failed"; output?: never; error: NormalizedToolError; latencyMs: number; } & { status: "succeeded" | "failed"; })>
```

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `executionId` | <code>string</code> | Yes | Execution identifier returned by `tools.execute`. |
| `options` | <code>WaitForExecutionOptions</code> | No | Poll interval and total timeout in milliseconds. |

**Returns:** <code>Promise&lt;(ExecutionBase &amp; &#123; userId: string; createdAt: string; startedAt?: string; completedAt?: string; readonly replayed?: true; readonly source?: ExecutionSource; readonly attachments?: ExecutionAttachmentSummary; &#125; &amp; &#123; status: "succeeded"; output: JsonValue; error?: never; latencyMs: number; &#125; &amp; &#123; status: "succeeded" &#124; "failed"; &#125;) &#124; (ExecutionBase &amp; &#123; userId: string; createdAt: string; startedAt?: string; completedAt?: string; readonly replayed?: true; readonly source?: ExecutionSource; readonly attachments?: ExecutionAttachmentSummary; &#125; &amp; &#123; status: "failed"; output?: never; error: NormalizedToolError; latencyMs: number; &#125; &amp; &#123; status: "succeeded" &#124; "failed"; &#125;)&gt;</code>

**Throws**

- EyeballError with `timeout` when the deadline expires, or the executor's normalized error for a failed request.
- Error When an injected polling clock returns a non-finite timestamp.

**Example**

```ts
import { Eyeball } from "@eyeball/sdk";

const eyeball = new Eyeball({
  apiKey: process.env.EYEBALL_API_KEY!,
  baseUrl: process.env.EYEBALL_EXECUTOR_URL!,
});

const execution = { executionId: "exe_01JZ6WA0Q73ZQ5B51SRYB6M4Z8" };

const terminal = await eyeball.executions.wait(execution.executionId, {
  pollMs: 500,
  timeoutMs: 60_000,
});
```

Local polling cadence and deadline for terminal execution state.

```ts no-check
export interface WaitForExecutionOptions {
  /** Milliseconds between polls. Defaults to 500. */
  pollMs?: number;
  /** Total milliseconds before a timeout error. Defaults to 60,000. */
  timeoutMs?: number;
}
```

| Property | Type | Required | Readonly | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `pollMs` | <code>number</code> | No | No | Milliseconds between polls. Defaults to 500. |
| `timeoutMs` | <code>number</code> | No | No | Total milliseconds before a timeout error. Defaults to 60,000. |

### `ExecutionAttachmentSummary`

Historical metadata-only summary of staged Eyeball files referenced by an
execution's validated canonical input.

`count` is always the number of distinct IDs in `fileIds`. The summary does
not include names, MIME types, sizes, expiry timestamps, input paths, inline
content, decoded content, or file bytes, and it can outlive the staged files.

```ts no-check
export interface ExecutionAttachmentSummary {
  readonly count: number;
  readonly fileIds: readonly FileId[];
}
```

| Property | Type | Required | Readonly | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `count` | <code>number</code> | Yes | Yes | — |
| `fileIds` | <code>readonly `file_$&#123;string&#125;`[]</code> | Yes | Yes | — |

### `ExecutionMode`



```ts no-check
export type ExecutionMode = "sync" | "async";
```

### `ExecutionRecord`



```ts no-check
export type ExecutionRecord = ExecutionBase & {
  userId: string;
  createdAt: string;
  startedAt?: string;
  completedAt?: string;
  /**
   * Present as literal `true` after at least one accepted idempotent replay has
   * been observed for this execution.
   *
   * A replay reuses this record's execution ID. Absence does not show whether
   * the original request carried an idempotency key. No raw idempotency key,
   * prefix, hash, scope, or other derivative is included.
   */
  readonly replayed?: true;
  /** Verified bounded origin metadata, when the execution has one. */
  readonly source?: ExecutionSource;
  /** Distinct staged-file IDs referenced by the validated execution input. */
  readonly attachments?: ExecutionAttachmentSummary;
} & (
    | {
        status: "pending" | "running";
        output?: never;
        error?: never;
        latencyMs?: never;
      }
    | {
        status: "succeeded";
        output: JsonValue;
        error?: never;
        latencyMs: number;
      }
    | {
        status: "failed";
        output?: never;
        error: NormalizedToolError;
        latencyMs: number;
      }
  );
```

### `ExecutionResult`

The immediate result of POST /v1/execute in either execution mode.

```ts no-check
export type ExecutionResult = SyncExecuteResponse | AsyncExecuteResponse;
```

### `ExecutionSource`

Verified public origin metadata for an execution.

A voice-session source is recorded only when the executor has verified the
session identity and its cryptographic binding to the reserved child
execution ID. Session grants, control tokens, and private worker headers are
never included.

```ts no-check
export type ExecutionSource = {
  readonly kind: "voice_session";
  readonly sessionId: string;
};
```

### `ExecutionStatus`



```ts no-check
export type ExecutionStatus = "pending" | "running" | "succeeded" | "failed";
```
